pageDescriptions.Home: Find real experiences from Norwegian students who have been on exchange. Search by country, university, course and study program.
pageDescriptions.Exchanges: Read detailed exchange experiences, course choices, ratings and recommendations from Norwegian students who have studied abroad.
pageDescriptions.Contact: Get in touch with questions, feedback or help related to exchange experiences and the portal.
pageDescriptions.Account: View and manage account information, settings and your exchange data.
pageDescriptions.Login: Log in to manage your profile, add or edit your exchange experiences.
pageDescriptions.Admin: Manage exchange data, users and content. Only available to administrators.
pageDescriptions.FAQ: Find answers to common questions about exchange, course choices, submitted experiences and using the portal.
pageDescriptions.Experiences: Read exchange experiences from Norwegian students who have been on exchange.
pageDescriptions.ExperienceDetail: Read an exchange experience from a Norwegian student who has been on exchange.
pageDescriptions.Courses: Explore courses Norwegian students have taken while on exchange, and see which subjects can be credited.
pageDescriptions.Terms and Conditions: Read legal information and terms of use for Utvekslingsportalen.
